purpose: Test whether a slow latent persistence/suitability state combined with faster conditional meadow condition is sufficient to reproduce the Tampa pattern: immediate memory in both observed state dimensions but robust older-history value only for coarse recorded state.

relationship_to_prior_tests.conditioning_audit: Removing persistent-presence conditioning did not restore older-history value for quantitative Tampa state.
relationship_to_prior_tests.new_mechanism: A two-timescale latent process, not simple thresholding of one first-order quantitative state.

known_truth.slow_state: site-specific latent persistence/suitability propensity h[i,t] following stationary Gaussian AR(1)
known_truth.fast_state: conditional meadow condition c[i,t] following an independent stationary Gaussian AR(1) on the logit scale
known_truth.important_property: Binary and quantitative observations still derive from exactly the same sampled count k. The added ingredient relative to the failed thresholding-only test is a distinct slow latent persistence state multiplying a faster conditional-condition state.

prediction_design.loss_both_states: mean squared error on common [0,1] scale; binary MSE is Brier score
prediction_design.lag1_model: common baseline + immediately previous observed state
prediction_design.older_history_model: lag1 model + exponentially weighted all-prior observed state
prediction_design.tau_reason: Transferred unchanged from the already-frozen Tampa coarse-state analysis and prior representation-matched quantitative replay.
prediction_design.split: Fit each arm once on target years 2-18; score the unchanged fitted model separately in heldout target years 19-28.

within_replicate_support_rule.signflip_test: exact one-sided paired sign-flip test of mean target-year MSE delta; p < 0.05
within_replicate_support_rule.lag1_support: Apply rule to lag1 minus baseline.
within_replicate_support_rule.older_history_support: Apply rule to older-history minus lag1.
within_replicate_support_rule.target_pattern: lag1 supported for both binary and quantitative states AND older history supported for binary state AND older history not supported for quantitative state.

cell_support_rule: A parameter cell supports the two-timescale mechanism when at least 50% of its 32 replicates satisfy the complete target pattern and the median replicate-level binary-minus-quantitative older-history relative-gain contrast is > 0.

global_support_rule.phi_slow_robustness: At least 2 of the 3 phi_slow levels must have at least 6 of their 8 cells satisfy the cell support rule.

secondary_outputs: lag1 and older-history support fractions separately by state and cell
older-history relative gains separately by state
forbidden_after_opening: Changing the grid or dropping unfavorable cells.
Changing the learner, loss, rows, or target years by state.
Changing the fast or slow process after seeing simulation outcomes.
Calling the mechanism necessary if the sufficiency test passes.
Calling biological long-memory proven by this response-free simulation.
interpretation_boundary: A positive result establishes sufficiency of a slow latent persistence state plus faster condition dynamics to reproduce the observed state-dimension memory pattern under shared sampling.
A negative result weakens this specific two-timescale explanation but does not prove the Tampa coarse-state signal is artifactual.
This is response-free known-truth mechanism evidence, not an additional ecological dataset.

pre_outcome_amendments.timing: before any simulation outcome or artifact was opened
pre_outcome_amendments.change: first_scored_target_year changed from 10 to 19; last remains 28
pre_outcome_amendments.reason: Preserve the predeclared exact sign-flip test while matching the earlier thresholding known-truth 10-year heldout window and keeping computation tractable.

pre_outcome_amendments.timing: before any simulation outcome or artifact was opened
pre_outcome_amendments.change: Replace repeated walk-forward refits with one frozen calibration fit on target years 2-18 and year-wise scoring on heldout years 19-28.
pre_outcome_amendments.reason: Match the earlier thresholding-only known-truth split exactly and reduce redundant fitting while preserving the paired 10-year exact sign-flip endpoint.
